_meta.method: Coordinates follow Russell's circumplex model of affect: valence (negative..positive, x-axis) and arousal (calm..activated, y-axis), both in [-1, 1]. Each family/cluster is placed at a hand-picked centroid reflecting its circumplex quadrant (e.g. anger = negative valence + high arousal, calm = positive valence + low arousal, sadness = negative valence + low arousal). Individual emotions take their family centroid plus a small deterministic offset (seeded by the emotion's own label via sha256, +/- 0.12 per axis) so siblings are not identical points. These values are heuristic approximations for calibrating Laya's choice questions, not empirically measured affect ratings.
notes: Justicia: A value/principle (fairness), not a felt emotion; placed near virtue-related positive states because it is commonly invoked as a moral feeling.
Integridad: A character trait/value, not a discrete emotion; placed with kindness/virtue states as a moral-self trait.
Hambruna: A situation/condition (famine), not an emotion; placed with social-injury negative states because it names extreme deprivation people react to.
Typo fixes applied to the source list: Hastio->Hastio con tilde (Hastío), Apreciacion->Apreciación, Autonomia->Autonomía, Codescendencia->Condescendencia, Fasticio->Fastidio (merged as duplicate).

Duplicate merges: Valentia appeared under Negative and Variable, kept once under Variable (ambivalent) as courage reads as context-dependent; Compromiso appeared under Positive and Variable, kept once under Positive; Lastima/Lástima merged to Lástima under Negative; Fastidio/Fasticio merged to Fastidio under Negative.

core_positive.description: All positive-polarity emotion families, from high-energy joy and being in love to calm contentment and confidence / Todas las familias de polaridad positiva, desde alegría de alta energía y estar enamorado/a hasta calma satisfecha y confianza en uno mismo. || All positive-polarity emotion families, spanning high-energy joy to calm contentment.

joy_elation.description: High-energy joy and elation: delight, euphoria, wanting to dance and celebrate / Alegría de alta energía y euforia: júbilo, ganas de bailar y celebrar. || High-energy joy and elation, from delight to euphoric peaks.

love_affection.description: Being in love, loving someone, romance, partner, tenderness, affection, closeness with others / Estar enamorado/a, amar a alguien, romance, pareja, cariño, ternura, cercanía con otras personas. || Warm relational bonds: affection, empathy, and closeness with others.

kindness_virtue.description: Prosocial virtues: generosity, honesty, moral integrity, doing the right thing / Virtudes prosociales: generosidad, honestidad, integridad moral, hacer lo correcto. || Prosocial virtues: generosity, honesty, and moral integrity.

confidence_achievement.description: Feeling capable, proud, motivated, ready to power through a goal or workout / Sentirse capaz, orgulloso/a, motivado/a, listo/a para lograr una meta o entrenar. || Self-assured, energized states tied to accomplishment and personal strength.

calm_contentment.description: Peaceful, settled, relaxed and quietly satisfied, wanting to unwind or rest / Paz, tranquilidad, relajación, satisfacción serena, ganas de relajarse o descansar. || Settled, low-arousal positive states: peace, balance, and quiet satisfaction.

hope_optimism.description: Forward-looking hope, optimism, anticipation, looking forward to something good / Esperanza, optimismo, ilusión, expectativa de algo bueno por venir. || Forward-looking positive anticipation and engaged interest.

social_support.description: Belonging, gratitude, feeling supported and cared for by others / Pertenencia, gratitud, sentirse acompañado/a y apoyado/a por otros. || Positive states rooted in belonging, gratitude, and mutual support.

positive.description: Positive polarity: the listener/lyrics feel good, upbeat, warm or content overall (happy, in love, proud, grateful, relaxed and satisfied) / Polaridad positiva: la persona se siente bien, animada, cálida o conforme en general (feliz, enamorada, orgullosa, agradecida, relajada y satisfecha).

acute_distress.description: Acute negative states felt strongly right now: grief, fear, anger, disgust, shame, stress / Estados negativos agudos que se sienten con fuerza en el momento: duelo, miedo, ira, asco, vergüenza, estrés. || Acute negative states with strong felt intensity: grief, fear, anger, disgust, shame, and stress.

sadness_grief.description: Deep sorrow, mourning, grief, heartbreak, crying over a loss / Tristeza profunda, duelo, luto, corazón roto, llorar por una pérdida. || Deep sorrow, mourning, and grief-related low-energy pain.

despair_hopelessness.description: Hopelessness, giving up, feeling like nothing will get better / Desesperanza, rendirse, sentir que nada va a mejorar. || Hopelessness and loss of motivation, from mild discouragement to despair.

fear_anxiety.description: Fear, dread, anxiety, panic, feeling threatened or on edge / Miedo, temor, ansiedad, pánico, sentirse amenazado/a o alterado/a. || Threat-driven high-arousal states: fear, dread, and anxious alarm.

anger_hostility.description: Hot anger, rage, fury, wanting to fight back, feeling furious at someone / Enojo intenso, ira, furia, ganas de pelear, estar furioso/a con alguien. || Hot, high-energy anger and hostile reactivity.

disgust_contempt.description: Disgust, revulsion, contempt, moral rejection of someone or something / Asco, repulsión, desprecio, rechazo moral hacia alguien o algo. || Aversion and moral rejection toward others or situations.

shame_guilt.description: Shame, guilt, embarrassment, feeling bad about oneself / Vergüenza, culpa, pena, sentirse mal con uno mismo. || Self-directed negative evaluation: shame, guilt, and diminished self-worth.

frustration_stress.description: Frustration, stress, tension from being blocked or overloaded / Frustración, estrés, tensión por sentirse bloqueado/a o sobrecargado/a. || Mid-to-high arousal tension from blocked goals and overload.

relational_decline.description: Negative states about relationships, competence and belonging: betrayal, loneliness, confusion, failure / Estados negativos sobre relaciones, capacidad y pertenencia: traición, soledad, confusión, fracaso. || Negative states tied to relationships, competence, and social standing: helplessness, confusion, betrayal, isolation, failure, and injustice.

helplessness_weakness.description: Powerlessness, feeling weak, fragile, dependent on others / Impotencia, sentirse débil, frágil, dependiente de otros. || Low-energy powerlessness and fragile dependency on others.

confusion_disorientation.description: Confusion, doubt, mental fog, not knowing what to think or do / Confusión, duda, niebla mental, no saber qué pensar o hacer. || Cognitive disorientation, doubt, and mental fog.

conflict_betrayal.description: Betrayal, being manipulated, interpersonal conflict and harm, heartbreak from a breakup / Traición, manipulación, conflicto interpersonal, corazón roto por una ruptura amorosa. || Interpersonal harm: betrayal, manipulation, and aggression.

loneliness_emptiness.description: Loneliness, isolation, feeling alone, empty, withdrawn / Soledad, aislamiento, sentirse solo/a, vacío/a, distante de los demás. || Withdrawal, isolation, and a felt sense of emptiness.

failure_instability.description: Failure, setback, instability, physical or emotional hurt / Fracaso, contratiempo, inestabilidad, dolor físico o emocional. || Setback-related pain: failure, instability, and physical or emotional hurt.

social_injury.description: Injury from injustice, incapacity or social distrust, being wronged / Daño por injusticia, incapacidad o desconfianza social, sentirse agraviado/a. || Injury from injustice, incapacity, and social distrust.

negative.description: Negative polarity: the listener/lyrics feel bad overall (sad, angry, afraid, ashamed, hopeless, lonely, hurt, betrayed or overwhelmed) / Polaridad negativa: la persona se siente mal en general (triste, enojada, asustada, avergonzada, sin esperanza, sola, herida, traicionada o abrumada).

ambivalent_core.description: Emotions whose valence depends on context or co-occurring appraisal: longing, desire, surprise, calm detachment, pride, submission, rejection, tender-intense love / Emociones cuya valencia depende del contexto: añoranza, deseo, sorpresa, calma distante, orgullo, resignación, rechazo, amor tierno-intenso. || Emotions whose valence depends on context or co-occurring appraisal: they can present as positive, negative, or neutral.

nostalgia_longing.description: Bittersweet reflection on the past, missing someone or something, wistful longing, missing an ex / Reflexión agridulce sobre el pasado, extrañar a alguien o algo, añoranza, extrañar a un ex. || Bittersweet reflection: longing, regret, and wistful distance.

desire_attraction.description: Wanting, craving, being attracted to someone or something, curiosity / Deseo, anhelo, atracción hacia alguien o algo, curiosidad. || Pulled-toward states of wanting: desire, attraction, and curiosity.

surprise_alarm.description: Sudden surprise or alarm that could tip positive or negative, being startled / Sorpresa o alarma súbita que puede resultar positiva o negativa, sobresalto. || Sudden high-arousal reactions that can tip positive or negative.

calm_composure.description: Steady, detached low-arousal composure that reads as neutral rather than warm, unbothered stillness / Calma distante y serena que se percibe neutral, quietud despreocupada. || Steady low-arousal composure that can read as positive or neutral.

submission_conformity.description: Yielding, giving in, low-energy conformity, resignation / Resignación, ceder, conformarse, bajo nivel de energía. || Yielding, low-energy conformity and detachment.

defiance_pride.description: Assertive, high-energy self-assertion, defiant pride that can read as strength or arrogance / Autoafirmación enérgica, orgullo desafiante que puede leerse como fortaleza o arrogancia. || Assertive, high-energy self-assertion that can read as strength or arrogance.

rejection_repudiation.description: Pushing away, rejection, distrust, refusing to accept someone or something / Rechazo, desconfianza, negarse a aceptar a alguien o algo. || Pushing away: rejection, distrust, and non-acceptance.

unity_tenderness.description: Tender connectedness mixing excitement and warmth, intense togetherness / Conexión tierna que mezcla emoción y calidez, unión intensa. || Tender connectedness and mixed excited-warm togetherness.

ambivalent.description: Ambivalent / mixed polarity: the feeling depends on context or blends good and bad at once (bittersweet nostalgia, wanting/desire, surprise, calm detachment, defiant pride, yielding, rejection, tender-but-intense love) -- not clearly all-good or all-bad / Polaridad ambivalente o mixta: el sentimiento depende del contexto o mezcla algo bueno y malo a la vez (nostalgia agridulce, deseo, sorpresa, calma distante, orgullo desafiante, resignación, rechazo, amor tierno pero intenso) -- no es claramente todo bueno ni todo malo.
